metas.name: ★ 8.9 · 2016 · O.J.: Made in America

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2008 · Dear Zachary: A Letter to a Son About His Father
metas.description: A filmmaker decides to memorialize a murdered friend when his friend's ex-girlfriend announces she is expecting his son.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2009 · The Cove
metas.description: Using state-of-the-art equipment, a group of activists, led by renowned dolphin trainer Ric O'Barry, infiltrate a cove near Taijii, Japan to expose both a shocking instance of animal abuse and a serious threat to human health.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2010 · Inside Job
metas.description: Takes a closer look at what brought about the 2008 financial meltdown.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2012 · The Act of Killing
metas.description: A documentary which challenges former Indonesian death-squad leaders to reenact their mass-killings in whichever cinematic genres they wish, including classic Hollywood crime scenarios and lavish musical numbers.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2016 · 13th
metas.description: An in-depth look at the prison system in the United States and how it reveals the nation's history of racial inequality.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1996 · Paradise Lost: The Child Murders at Robin Hood Hills
metas.description: A horrific triple child murder leads to an indictment and trial of three nonconformist boys based on questionable evidence.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2019 · Collective

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2014 · The Internet's Own Boy: The Story of Aaron Swartz
metas.description: The story of programming prodigy and information activist Aaron Swartz, who took his own life at the age of 26.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2011 · Paradise Lost 3: Purgatory

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2002 · Bowling for Columbine

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2010 · Exit Through the Gift Shop

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1988 · The Thin Blue Line
metas.description: A film that successfully argued that a man was wrongly convicted for murder by a corrupt justice system in Dallas County, Texas.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2012 · West of Memphis

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2006 · Cocaine Cowboys

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2003 · Capturing the Friedmans
metas.description: Documentary on the Friedmans, a seemingly typical, upper-middle-class Jewish family whose world is instantly transformed when the father and his youngest son are arrested and charged with shocking and horrible crimes.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2020 · Athlete A
metas.description: Follow the Indianapolis Star reporters that broke the story about USA Gymnastics doctor Larry Nassar's abuse and hear from gymnasts like Maggie Nichols.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2000 · Paradise Lost 2: Revelations
